author: Mark Atwood
text: Resolution evidence (worker6): the three-way contradiction is real on main (reproduced in detached worktree at b48d1e5de4: ipv6_address_vectors 2 FAILED at :130/:267) but is a MERGE-RESOLUTION CLOBBER, not missing work. Facts: (a) yggdrasil_address.json on main IS already stripped to upstream_addr_for_key vectors (14 vectors, rejected note present) - the 'still rejected SHA-512' premise is stale; (b) main's generator+corpus already emit native/native_packed/iid_in_native as upstream AddrForKey values (merge-resolution comment in generate_ipv6_addresses.py:74-84 explicitly chose beads-worker-3's Design B over HEAD's no-native-fields shape); (c) the only missing piece was the Rust absence-assertion flip = ex92's unmerged 877e34b641. Done here on beads-worker-6: took main's generator/corpus/python consumers (Design B), ported ex92's ipv6_address_vectors.rs flip verbatim (conditional native_packed==upstream AddrForKey byte-equality + IID non-embedding rejection; binding_invariant_rejected accepted in yggdrasil_addr_vectors.rs). Verified: cargo test -p lichen-core full suite green (420 lib + all vector files incl. 4/4 + 5/5), pytest tests/ipv6 129 passed, generate_ipv6_addresses.py --check byte-exact, fmt/clippy clean, chmod 755 test/vectors applied locally per the P3 note. NOTE for merge: beads-worker-6 lacks main's 7331d087c5 DAO migration, so 34 dao_origin test_vectors failures exist on my branch WITHOUT my changes (verified via stash) - they resolve at the janitor merge, not usyc scope. The janitor merge of beads-worker-6 should resolve any residual conflict in these 8 files in favor of this commit (Design B + ex92 flip).
